name: talent-alpha
description: A nightly-or-on-demand scan of layoff/WARN notices and funding-distress news that scores every signal against your open role and emails or renders a single ranked card: who just became reachable, why now, your outreach hook, and your concrete edge. A fast scanner shortlists candidates, then two independent judges (an Advocate and a Skeptic) argue each one before it is reconciled onto the card, so no single model grades its own work. Ships both as a standalone n8n workflow (for a real scheduled nightly run) and as this Cowork/Claude Code plugin (for the identical pipeline run on demand, in-session). Ships in the talentai marketplace beside the other three recruiting kits, and installs on its own.
